findings.body: Two existing workflow tests still require five Windows groups: `tests/test_ci_platform_group_counts.py:13` supplies count 5 to the exact matrix assertion at line 20, and `tests/test_fix_windows_test_jobs_are_cancelled_at_their.py:21` asserts exactly five Windows entries with 20-minute limits. Both assertions fail against this eight-group matrix. CI runs the full `tests` directory (`.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:45`), so the workflow tests will fail despite the successful close run, which selected only `tests/test_rules.py`. Update both stale expectations to eight while retaining their timeout checks.
